title: project
description: Result of `stride project <YYYY-MM-DD> ["<date>=<target>,..."]` (ADR 0010, ADR 0019): CTL/ATL/TSB on the target date, folded by the same recurrence daily_load runs — over the RECORDED open plan (plan_source: recorded), or over a caller-passed hypothetical plan that REPLACES it in the walk (plan_source: hypothetical). Every target kind is priced on its own rung: power as TSS against the ride FTP, pace as rTSS against its family's threshold speed, a heart-rate band or zone as hrTSS, a session rating as session-RPE load. A session the inputs cannot price adds nothing and is listed in unprojected with its reason. The hypothetical is echoed back (dates as given, targets in canonical form, so 1x60:00@Z2 echoes as 1x1:00:00@Z2) and never stored — the recorded plan stays the single source of adherence truth. stride never solves for the plan that reaches a target: plan to consequences only.

unprojected.description: Each session in the window that adds no load, with why: no_target (no structured target), no_ftp (a power target with no ride FTP on file), no_hr_zones (a heart-rate band with no zones configured), no_threshold_pace (a pace target whose sport families have no 60-day threshold on file, or whose intensity against the nearest one exceeds the 1.5 bound analyze enforces). sessions_considered minus sessions_projected counts them.

target_literal.description: The session's target in canonical form; empty when it has none.

hypothetical.description: The caller's plan, echoed back with dates as given and each target in canonical form (1x60:00@Z2 echoes as 1x1:00:00@Z2); empty for plan_source: recorded.

dur_s.description: Seconds per rep; 0 for a distance rep.

watts.description: Target watts; 0 for every kind but power.
